text:
amanda: noticing p99 latency spikes on prod under sustained long-context load. looks correlated with eviction churn and a bunch of reinsert loops. p50 ok, p99 up ~120ms. symptoms: KV size oscillates + memory growth over 30s.

ravi: can you paste the short repro? which model/seq len?

amanda: small repro: run loadgen with seq=8k, batch 8, request mix tilt=chatty. here's quick cmd:
```
./loadgen --model redwood-7b --seq 8192 --batch 8 --duration 2m
```
I'm seeing eviction_reinsert count jump x10 after ~40s.

diego: saw something similar on staging yesterday. I profiled evicter and found repeated evict+reinsert cycles touching same slab -> fragmentation + thrash. flamegraph posted to the ticket.

amanda: attaching logs snippet:
```
[evicter] evict entry id=0x7f2a count=1 reinsert=3 -> pager wake
[kv] reuse_hit=12 reuse_miss=110 evict_reinsert=312
```

sara: could this be from the LRU -> FIFO hybrid changes? we recently relaxed probation window. commit 9f3b2a seems related.

diego: yep commit 9f3b2a reduced probation weight. When under surge, FIFO path starts cycling hot entries. I'll try reverting locally.

ravi: also check kernel selection change last week that reduced page_size from 64kb->32kb on some builds. smaller pages -> more fragmentation and more frequent evictions.

amanda: quick experiment: flip `kv.evict_mode` to `lru_strict` on one canary and p99 stabilizes immediately. interestingly p50 unchanged.

sara: metric idea: emit `evict_reinsert_latency_ms` and `evict_reinsert_count_by_entry` to detect reinsert hotspots. Also add `evicter_retry_backoff_ms` randomized small jitter to break tight loops.

diego: dug into the codepath and found a race in evicter handshake where tombstone wasn't set before reinsert -> double insert and immediate eviction. fix candidate: make tombstone set atomic with CAS in `insert_or_mark`.

amanda: can we ship a small mitigation first (randomized backoff + probation tightened) then ship atomic fix? what's timeline?

ravi: mitigation PR up: #2386 passes unit tests and local stress.

ci-bot: build green, running perf benches on canary...

ci-bot: perfbench results: branch vs main -> p99 120ms -> 66ms, evict_reinsert_count -70%.

sara: plan: roll mitigation to all-canary -> monitor 15m -> if stable schedule atomic fix for next patch release. owner: diego. I'll update runbook.

diego: taking owner. will open atomic-fix PR today and link perf numbers + a small reproducer.

amanda: thanks all. leaving monitoring on and logs in #incidents. will post follow-up if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
